headings: Recursive answers customer questions so you can get back to work.
pages.text:
AI-powered support agents for small businesses. See Recursive in action — ask about pricing, features, and how to get started.
Recursive answers customer questions so you can get back to work.
We turn your existing docs into a tool that answers customer questions 24/7 — from humans in a chat window and from other AI agents programmatically. It says 'I don't know' instead of making things up. We're rolling out access gradually — sign up for early access and we'll reach out as spots open up.
Plans start at $49/mo, no setup fee.
